result.description:
Plant Inspector – Perth (Full-Time)
About ACTS
Asset Conformity Testing Services (ACTS) is an established, NATA-accredited ISO/IEC 17020 inspection body delivering independent asset inspection, testing, and integrity services across the mining and mineral processing, oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, rail, and port sectors. 
We provide practical, innovative, and compliance-focused solutions, including engineering services, third-party inspections, and NDT services, tailored to support our clients’ reliability, safety, and regulatory requirements. 
About the Role
We are looking for a certified and experienced Plant Inspector to join our Perth Inspection Team to conduct Plant inspections throughout Western Australia. You will ideally have experience in a similar inspection role. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a young company and play an important role in our growth journey. 
The role includes FIFO (rostered or project-based) and Perth metro work, based out of our High Wycombe office, Monday to Friday with overtime as required.
You will work alongside project engineers, maintenance teams, HSE personnel and other relevant stakeholders to ensure all plant meets regulatory requirements and industry best practice. API510 or AICIP is essential.
Role Accountabilities
•	Perform inspections, testing, and audits on registered plant, including pressure vessels, cranes, and lifting equipment, using specialist inspection and testing equipment
•	Prepare high-quality inspection and compliance reports tailored to client and regulatory requirements
•	Use knowledge and skills, from qualifications and experience, to assess compliance in accordance with relevant WA legislation and Standards.
•	Liaise with site engineers, supervisors, and maintenance teams to prioritise remedial works.
•	Provide technical support and advice related to compliance matters to clients.
•	Liaise with Department of Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety and Worksafe on client’s registered plant assets.
What we are looking for
Applicants must possess the following:
•	API510 or AICIP Pressure equipment inspection qualifications and relevant experience in the inspections space.
•	Demonstrated experience in the inspection of cranes and lifting equipment.
•	Good understanding of all relevant Australian Standards applicable to the Plant Inspection role in Western Australia.
•	Attention to detail, report writing skills, self-motivated to comply with client reporting timelines.
•	Good written and verbal communication skills.
•	Current WA drivers’ license.
•	Willingness to travel to site as required.
Desirable Criteria
•	AINDT/ PCN/ ISO 9712 NDT qualifications/API 653 certification
•	Experience working with Tier-1 mining operators (Rio Tinto, FMG, BHP or similar)
•	Engineering background, trade qualification, or High-Risk Work Licence
About the position
•	Permanent Full-time position. 
•	Attractive remuneration package aligned with your experience, certifications, and industry standards, including competitive base salary, overtime rates, and FIFO / site allowances where applicable
•	Join an experienced, and supportive team, with genuine opportunities to contribute to and grow with ACTS
•	Career progression opportunities, supported by ongoing training, mentoring, and professional development, including support for additional inspection certifications and industry-recognised qualifications
•	Exposure to diverse range of projects and clients across the WA resources and other sectors.
Remuneration
•	Attractive remuneration package aligned with your experience, certifications, and industry standards, including competitive base salary, overtime rates, and FIFO / site allowances where applicable
Apply online today to be considered for this exciting opportunity.

result.description:
TWK Steel is an Australian based steel fabrication business specialising in large scale civil and infrastructure projects. Servicing clients across the country, we offer a range of fabricated steel solutions which are designed to meet the needs of the Australian market. TWK Steel is also a stockist of Nippon Steel sheet pile, manufactured in Japan. Combining innovation with exceptional quality products, TWK Steel has been designing, manufacturing and delivering our clients with bespoke steel solutions for over a decade.

With the capacity to deliver over 10,000 ton of fabricated steel per year, TWK Steel provides you with the peace of mind that quality, safety and cost-efficiency are at the forefront of our business.

We are seeking qualified Welders to join our dedicated team of professionals. We are looking for hardworking individuals who can meet company challenges and surpass client expectations.

As a Welder, your core responsibilities involve reading blueprints, preparing materials, operating cutting tools, and assembling structural components while adhering to strict safety protocols.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
